decisions.modes: executable modes are exactly [answer]; explain/feature are plannedModes and are rejected as unknown options
decisions.boundary: empty/whitespace query and limit outside 1..100 are refused by validateToolArguments (shared by MCP and CLI) with the same words the handler emits
decisions.envelope: answer responses always carry provenance and declared bounds; no match list is invented

limitations: The gate drives the SOURCE CLI/MCP entries (dist/ is a build artifact, rebuilt centrally).
The corpus leg lives in verify-ask-e2e-corpus; this gate is a small fixture by design.
